title: Store Associate Guide — Returns, Reallocation, Withdrawal and Payoff Windows on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

# Store Associate Guide — Returns, Reallocation, Withdrawal and Payoff Windows on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

When a customer who financed a purchase on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan brings merchandise back, asks to move the purchase to a different promotional term, changes their mind about the financing, or asks for a payoff figure, the window that applies is the one the plan's promotional term sets. The figures are below.

## Windows by term

| Term | Business days within which a return credit must appear on the plan | Return credit rebuilds the remaining schedule | Calendar days within which a down payment is refundable if the sale is unwound | Purchase may be moved to a different term after the sale | Calendar days after the sale within which a purchase may be moved | Calendar days after the sale within which the financing and the sale may be unwound together | Calendar days a quoted payoff figure stays good for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 5 | no | 3 | no | 0 | 3 | 10 |
| 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 5 | no | 3 | no | 0 | 3 | 10 |
| 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 5 | no | 5 | yes | 30 | 3 | 10 |
| 24-Month Equal Payment Plan | 7 | yes | 5 | yes | 30 | 5 | 14 |
| 36-Month Equal Payment Plan | 7 | yes | 7 | yes | 45 | 5 | 14 |
| 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan | 7 | yes | 7 | yes | 60 | 7 | 14 |

## What the associate reads from the table

- **Return credit posting** must land within 5 business days on the three deferred interest terms and within 7 business days on the three equal payment terms. Whether the credit rebuilds the remaining payment schedule rather than only shortening the plan is *no* on the deferred interest terms and *yes* on the equal payment terms.
- **The down payment refund window** is 3 calendar days on the two shortest terms, 5 on the 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan and the 24-Month Equal Payment Plan, and 7 on the two longest terms.
- **Reallocation** to a different promotional term is not offered on the 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan or the 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan (their window stands at 0 days); it is offered within 30 calendar days of the sale on the 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan and the 24-Month Equal Payment Plan, within 45 days on the 36-Month Equal Payment Plan, and within 60 days on the 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan.
- **The cooling-off window** for unwinding the financing and the sale together is 3 calendar days on the three deferred interest terms, 5 on the 24-Month Equal Payment Plan and the 36-Month Equal Payment Plan, and 7 on the 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan.
- **A payoff quote** stays good for 10 calendar days on the deferred interest terms and 14 calendar days on the equal payment terms.
